tool_schemas.name: parse_documents
tool_schemas.description: Submits a document to the MinerU conversion pipeline, creates a new conversion job, and returns the created job record (including its initial lifecycle state and any persisted source metadata such as filename, content type, size, and sha256 when provided). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if source_kind is not one of the allowed values, if required source details are missing/inconsistent for the chosen source_kind (e.g., url/local_path without a locator), or if requested_ocr_language is provided but does not match an existing ocr_languages.code; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to submit jobs; raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED if job submission limits are reached; raises CONFLICT if the request attempts to create a duplicate/incompatible job for the same sha256 according to server deduplication rules.

source_kind.description: Type of document source being submitted for conversion.

source_locator.description: Location of the source document (e.g., URL or local path); ignored for upload-based submissions.

original_filename.description: Original filename for the submitted document (useful for auditing and downstream naming).

content_type.description: MIME content type of the source document (e.g., application/pdf).

size_bytes.description: Size of the source document in bytes.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the source document for deduplication/integrity checks.

requested_ocr_language.description: Requested OCR language code (must exist in ocr_languages.code).

tool_schemas.name: get_ocr_languages
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paginated list of OCR languages known to the service (optionally filtered by is_enabled and/or engine_provider) along with a next-page cursor when more results are available; results are ordered by the requested sort and page size is controlled by limit. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if limit is invalid, cursor is malformed/expired, sort is not supported, or engine_provider is not one of the allowed values. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to view the language catalog.

is_enabled.description: If provided, filters languages by enabled/disabled status.

engine_provider.description: If provided, filters languages by OCR engine provider.

limit.description: Maximum number of languages to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: list_conversion_jobs
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paginated list of conversion jobs, optionally filtered by lifecycle status, source_kind, requested OCR language, and created_at range. Results are ordered by the requested sort and include a next-page cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any filter is malformed (e.g., invalid status/source_kind), if limit is out of range, or if cursor is malformed/expired.

status.description: If provided, filters jobs by lifecycle status.

source_kind.description: If provided, filters jobs by source kind.

requested_ocr_language.description: If provided, filters jobs by requested OCR language code.

created_at_gte.description: If provided, filters to jobs created at or after this timestamp (RFC 3339).

created_at_lte.description: If provided, filters to jobs created at or before this timestamp (RFC 3339).

limit.description: Maximum number of jobs to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: get_conversion_job
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single conversion job by id and returns the persisted job record including lifecycle status and timestamps. Raises NOT_FOUND if no such job exists or is not visible to the caller.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_conversion_job
tool_schemas.description: Requests cancellation of a conversion job by id. If the job is in queued or running, transitions it to cancelled, sets finished_at, and returns the updated job record. If the job is already succeeded/failed/cancelled, returns the current record without changing state. Raises NOT_FOUND if the job does not exist.

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason recorded for auditing.

tool_schemas.name: list_conversion_outputs
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paginated list of conversion outputs for a given job_id, optionally filtered by output_type and/or format. Results are ordered by the requested sort and include a next-page cursor when more results are available. Raises NOT_FOUND if the job does not exist. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if filters are invalid or cursor is malformed/expired.

job_id.description: Conversion job id whose outputs should be listed.

output_type.description: If provided, filters outputs by output type.

format.description: If provided, filters outputs by format (e.g., markdown, json, txt).

limit.description: Maximum number of outputs to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: list_job_artifacts
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paginated list of artifacts produced for a given job_id, optionally filtered by artifact_type and/or page_number. Results are ordered by the requested sort and include a next-page cursor when more results are available. Raises NOT_FOUND if the job does not exist. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if filters are invalid or cursor is malformed/expired.

job_id.description: Conversion job id whose artifacts should be listed.

artifact_type.description: If provided, filters artifacts by type.

page_number.description: If provided, filters artifacts to a specific page number (1-based).

limit.description: Maximum number of artifacts to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

metadata.name: MinerU Document Conversion Server
